verdict.rationale: Fivetran's evidence describes a fully managed cloud SaaS/hybrid pipeline platform with pre-built connectors, REST API, and Connector SDK for building custom Python connectors, plus AI agent skills to 'build, test, and deploy connectors' (fivetran-intdir-6), but there is no evidence of a local, lightweight-destination testing workflow (e.g., a local sync/dry-run mode against a sandbox destination) that lets an engineer validate a pipeline before it touches production.
